Assam floods: 82 dead, over 1.92 lakh affected as rains continue

Flooding in Assam has resulted in 82 deaths and affected over 1.92 lakh people across several districts. While the number of affected people has decreased from previous days, 379 villages remain inundated. The state government has announced relief measures, including six-month loan moratoriums in four worst-hit districts and assistance with insurance and loans. Railway tracks have been severely damaged, impacting transportation.
